'''Double Trouble with Dialga and Palkia III''' (Japanese: '''VS ディアルガ&パルキアIII''' ''VS Dialga & Palkia III''), titled '''VS Dialga & Palkia III''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 413th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 76th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}.

It is subtitled '''Roar of Time and Spacial Rend''' (Japanese: '''"ときのほうこう"と"あくうせつだん"''' ''"Roar of Time" and "Subspace Tear"'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Roar of Time and Spatial Rend''' in the Chuang Yi translation.

==Plot==
{{spoilers}}
With {{adv|Diamond}} on its back, {{DL|Diamond (Adventures)|Moo}} charges toward {{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Dialga}}, ramming its icy tusks into its chest. Before Diamond and Moo are able to repeat the attack, {{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Palkia}} raises its arm, and the two suddenly find themselves hurtling into a column. Realizing that Palkia is able to tear through space with its attacks, {{adv|Pearl}} sends out {{DL|Pearl (Adventures)|Zeller}}, {{DL|Pearl (Adventures)|Digler}}, and {{DL|Pearl (Adventures)|Tauler}} to join the fight. The three Pokémon do a combination attack that shoves Dialga into Palkia, giving Diamond the opportunity to use a powerful {{type|ice}} move on them both.

Suddenly, time begins to rewind, and Dialga unleashes an attack on the two and their Pokémon, knocking them down. Knowing they have to stop Dialga and Palkia in order to save [[Sinnoh]], Diamond and Pearl try to figure out their next move. 

Riding on [[Cynthia]]'s {{TP|Cynthia|Garchomp}}, {{adv|Platinum}} calls out to the two from above as they continue their battle. When she descends from Garchomp with Cynthia, they find the [[Gym Leader]]s lying in rubble, wounded. [[Candice]] calls out to Platinum and gives her a [[Poké Ball]] containing a {{TP|Platinum|Froslass}} to help with the fight. [[Gardenia]] and [[Maylene]] also each give Platinum a Poké Ball, containing a {{p|Cherrim}} and [[Volkner]]'s {{p|Pachirisu}} respectively.

As Platinum tries to thank them all, Palkia prepares to launch an attack. Candice shoves her out of the way just in time, but the Poké Balls fall loose from Platinum's grasp. Angry, Platinum tries to charge at Palkia, but she and Cynthia are nearly struck by an attack and knocked over. As Platinum hits the ground, she spots a scroll falling from Cynthia's coat. Platinum is able to decipher its ancient writing, reading aloud the phrases "{{m|Roar of Time}}" and "{{m|Spacial Rend}}." Shocked that Platinum can understand it, Cynthia explains that the scroll may have answers about Dialga and Palkia. Platinum realizes that since [[Cyrus]] was likely to have read from the scroll, it may explain how to stop the two [[Legendary Pokémon]]. 

As Platinum becomes determined to decipher the ancient writing, Cynthia realizes that Cyrus is nowhere to be found.

==Major events==
* {{adv|Diamond}} and {{adv|Pearl}} begin battling {{p|Dialga}} and {{p|Palkia}}.
* {{adv|Platinum}} receives a {{TP|Platinum|Froslass}} from [[Candice]], a {{p|Cherrim}} from [[Gardenia]], and a {{p|Pachirisu}} from [[Maylene]], who got it from [[Volkner]].
